user_authority: User explicitly states no new samples, authorizes reorganizing existing samples, new train/test split, retraining and evaluation; supersedes roadmap68 locked-new-input prerequisite, old-role preservation, no-training stage87 restriction and no-baseline-refit rule for this bounded experiment.
scope: all already cached selected records with actual audited62/raw/status: stage55+56 readout plus new-only stage70/81/82/83 support; no new ROOT/reconstruction/generation, no inferred fitted-charge substitutes
split: canonical source groups, component-stratified seeded permutation; rounded15% test,15%cal,remaining train. Assign without target/prediction. Same incoming in several roles: test>cal>train; quarantine lower-priority rows. Quarantined events retained in identity cache, not energy-quality deleted.
weights: within each role, all views of a native-MeV incoming key share total loss/metric weight1; record-weighted metrics secondary
test_scope: held out from the new fits, previously exposed research pool; NOT new blind or independent confirmation. No test-based hyperparameter/model/prior selection.

baseline.initialization: weighted mean training logE with boost_from_average disabled, same for all seeds
baseline.calibration: one incoming-weighted mean cal log residual for ensemble

preprocessing: train-only column median/IQR, constant/all-missing scale1, normalized values cap[-20,20] fixed for numerical stability; explicit per-column NaN flag plus observed wave/fit/Calo flags; fit only new train

bounded_residual.anchor: E_base=pz0/0.8 GeV, traditional neutrino estimate; not vertex-muon truth
bounded_residual.prediction: log E_base + g(x)*log(64)*tanh(r(x)); g=sigmoid(g_head); no hard pz switch
bounded_residual.loss: unit logE MSE for all events +0.1 BCE(g, physical transfer fraction>=0.2) on valid physical labels; unconfirmed valid vertex labels kept
bounded_residual.calibration: one unit global mean log residual from original cal, applied once; report raw and calibrated, calibrated preselected

posterior.near_zero: one continuous component on fraction[0,0.1); no delta mass at zero
posterior.positive: two continuous components on fraction[0.1,1); fixed K, no component search
posterior.transforms: r=log((E_mu_vertex-m_mu)/pz0), f=a+(b-a)*sigmoid(s); per component independent Normal(r) and Normal(s), weights softmax. E_mu=m_mu+pz0*exp(r), h=E_mu*f/(1-f), E_nu=E_mu+h. This models truth-muon response rather than treating reco pz as truth
posterior.scale: sigma=0.05+4.95*sigmoid(head); both latent dimensions; scales in dimensionless transformed units
posterior.supervised_loss: joint proper density NLL on physical labels (include transform Jacobian; truth response of unconfirmed track kept), +0.25 marginal logE NLL on ALL events; unknown/nonphysical labels get only marginal energy NLL, not pseudo transfer supervision
posterior.boundary: exact f=0 or f=0.1 truth if present treated as fixed-width 1e-6 fraction interval-censored likelihood, never clipped target; E_mu<=m_mu labeled unknown and retains marginal energy loss
posterior.integration: 32-point Gauss-Hermite per component over s for marginal energy density, analytic r inverse/Jacobian at given E; fixed deterministic quadrature for CDF, quantiles and PIT; no stochastic spectrum toys
posterior.calibration: two scalars only: add b to all r means, multiply all r scales by T; fit original cal marginal energy NLL, b[-0.2,0.2],T[0.5,2], fixed L-BFGS-B starting(0,1),<=100 iterations. Preserves E_nu=E_mu+h; cal/eval still developed
posterior.point: posterior median primary (not mean-logE); report exp(E[logE]) as named diagnostic only; no eval winner selection
posterior.intervals: central68% and90% posterior quantiles; CDF(Etruth)=PIT; tail probabilities and 10 fixed probability bins reliability

posterior_precision: torch float32 network and training; stable logsumexp,32-point GH; independent64/128-point numerical sensitivity after fit, main stays32 even if numerical concerns flagged
calibration: incoming-weighted new cal only: direct+bounded one global offset; posterior shared r-location b[-.2,.2] and scale T[.5,2], L-BFGS-B max100; no other optimization on cal or test

prior_stress.nominal: new train historical nominal-view-only incoming-weighted mass+0.5/bin
prior_stress.flat: uniform logE[50,6400], preserve training outside mass
prior_stress.main: nominal after cal; training-prior and flat/pressure named diagnostics only; no extra weighted fit
prior_stress.ESS: truth-weight and posterior probability-mass ESS fraction; <.2 unsupported

bootstrap: 500 incoming-key-within-component conditional draws seed2026110387+rolecode; known source/incoming connected blocks separately inventoried (3 per role), source intervals NOT estimable. Incoming CI is conditional on supplied source/response mix, not a substitute for source95%.

acceptance.additional_protected: pz50_100 and trueE>=200 explicitly: RMSE upper/F7<=1.03 and each total/positive/negative tail50 difference upper<=2pp
acceptance.posterior: all, two lowE, lowpz truehighE, high-y, unconfirmed, missing: central68/90 coverage with500 source intervals; supported stratum requires lower95>=nominal-5pp; mean PIT95 includes0.5, ten-bin PIT/quantile reliability shown; sparse cannot certify; report R68,width,logscore,CRPS(logE), not coverage alone
acceptance.decision: joint gates required, not independent95% claims; untouched confirmation required; no grid/retry on failure

acceptance_reference_amendment: fresh direct62 ensemble on SAME new split replaces old F7 for paired relative risk; old cached F7 on reassigned rows cannot be treated as held-out. Old original gates and stage86 numbers stay historical. No untouched confirmation claim.
stop: five formal models only, fixed epochs/seeds/capacity. No test-driven scans/retraining. Numerical or statistical insufficiency reported, not hidden by picking another main policy.
proposed_next: evaluate actual result then freeze next task; no automatic extra stage
pre_fit_identity_amendment: After source/incoming split audit, each role has one connected block per pi/k/charm (3 total); no within-component source replication. Source-level intervals unmeasured. Report500 incoming-key-within-component conditional draws, explicitly excluding source correlations/refits/response/research selection; no independent confirmation.
optimization_details: Adam default beta/epsilon, no weight decay, global gradient norm cap10 fixed before any fit; MLP train loss uses incoming-normalized weights; no optimizer/pilot step in QA.
proper_scoring: Marginal logE NLL from32-point GH; CRPS(logE) from fixed16 r x32 s probability quadrature, approximation reported; no stochastic spectra or observed-test-driven quadrature choice.
